description: Tray-click mini summary: reads snapshots, listens for updates, and toggles its own pin/visibility through Rust commands. Rust still owns all sizing and positioning — the one exception is start-dragging, which cannot be driven from Rust because a native drag has to begin from the webview's own pointer press. Dragging is how the summary is moved to another screen; Rust observes where it lands and anchors it there.
